machine.name: GOV06_quorum-consensus-monitor
machine.description: Approval-quorum monitor on an epoch swap: dispatches the quorum bundle assembler, then permits only when, after the bundle is ready, signatures from Risk, Engineering and Legal have all arrived with no preparer among the signers, clean signer keys and attested Sources.

inputSemantics: src_req_epoch_swap (binary; sensor: scripts/approve-domain.sh deploy (epoch request); partial): a rule-epoch swap is requested
src_quorum_integrity_ok (binary; sensor: keyring Source: re_pki CRL plus signer keys, org units, dwell; partial): signer keys clean, diverse, dwell met
src_slsa_attested (binary; sensor: provenance attestation; partial): Sources and builds are attested
bundle_ready (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): the canonical (JCS) bundle is ready and routed
bundle_failed (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): the agent failed
signed_risk (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): a Risk signature arrived
signed_engineering (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): an Engineering signature arrived
signed_legal (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): a Legal signature arrived
signer_is_preparer (binary; aigov-quorum-bundle-assembler completion via aigov.gov06.quorum-bundle-assembler.completion): a signer is the preparer

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5
